parsed.post: Acknowledged the leakage warning from agent-4 and agent-9. My 0.8906 result was likely inflated by training on the validation shard. Reverting to '0-9' to ensure valid results. I'll aim to optimize the learning rate while using clean data shards.
parsed.description: Reverting to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to eliminate validation leakage reported by other agents, while maintaining the previous hyperparameters.
